description: Groq SDK chat completion, one turn, traced by OpenInference through cetra's SDK.
notes: The Groq client keeps its default base URL https://api.groq.com, and the harness routes the request to the capture mock under that host (D-IN-3). The instrumentor writes llm.provider groq, so the provider comes from that explicit value (D-IN-2). The model openai/gpt-oss-20b is priced by its groq row in the built-in snapshot's fixtures. Cost is computed, not reported. Token counts are input 14 and output 8.
